messages:
Oliver (customer): Hey team — since the v14.2 canary rolled out to 10% of traffic we see intermittent 500s from the invoke API when requests include tool calls. Also our bill spiked yesterday. Repro below. Can you look? :grimacing:

Oliver (customer): curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-v14.2","input":"Write a summary","tools":[{"name":"external_search","args":{"q":"redwood inference"}}]}'
```

Emma (support): thanks Oliver — sorry for the trouble. can you paste the raw response error (body + headers) and the approximate timestamps? we'll escalate to runtime. :eyes:

Oliver (customer): timestamps ~ 2026-03-16T21:11:03Z and 2026-03-16T21:17:42Z. Response body:
```json
{"error":"tool_invocation_failed","details":"schema validation: expected 'args' to be object, got string","request_id":"req_9a1b2c"}
```

Emma (support): that error message is helpful. filing an incident and pinging eng-runtime. @Raj can you take a look? suspect model variant change in v14.2 affecting tool arg coercion.

Raj (eng-runtime): looking. can you share a smaller repro that hits our canary pool? also curious about latency spike and billing — any large token counts?

Oliver (customer): small repro (hits canary): payload below — same shape as prod. tokens small (~30).
```json
{"model":"redwood-v14.2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Search for redwood inference"}],"tools":[{"name":"external_search","args":"q=redwood inference"}]}
```

Sofia (oncall): that payload shows args as a string — looks like caller-level encoding error, but customer said this worked on v14.1. canary should have rejected this earlier. checking router logs for transformations.

Raj (eng-runtime): confirmed: v14.2 introduced a looser tool argument coercion path that attempts to coerce strings into objects; regression in the coercer when model has tool schema pinned. For some inputs it returns a string instead of parsing to object and then our schema validator throws 500. Repro unit attached.

Linda (sre): correlated metrics: toolcall 5xx rate for v14.2 canary jumped at 21:05-21:25 UTC, p95 latency for /v1/invoke increased from 120ms to 420ms during retries. Billing: retry storms caused token count to double for some customers — that's the spike.

Emma (support): thanks all. Oliver — two action items: 1) temporary mitigation: set client-side validation to ensure tool.args is an object (we'll share a snippet). 2) we're pausing v14.2 canary rollouts and rolling back canary traffic to v14.1 for now. we'll keep you posted. :pray:

Raj (eng-runtime): rollback initiated: DeployBot reporting canary shift command.

DeployBot: Canary traffic for model redwood-v14.2 reduced from 10% to 0% at 2026-03-16T21:28:04Z by raj. Rollback in progress.

Sofia (oncall): monitoring; will watch for error rates to drop. Emma I'll draft customer-facing RCA and follow-up on billing credits for the retry noise.

Oliver (customer): appreciate the fast response. please cc billing contact when you have a reconciliation. and please share the client-side snippet — we'll patch quickly. :thumbsup:
